answer_1.quote: We validate the performance through objective and subjective evaluations of spoken responses. ... The human evaluation also indicates that the proposed method yields more reasonable and proper response speech than the text-only LLM baseline approach.
answer_1.outputs: spoken responses (speech) with predicted speaking style and generated text

answer_2.quote: We adopt the widely-used text generation metric, including lexical-level score (BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR), and semantic-level (BERT Score). For response style evaluation, we calculate the Weighted F1 score for speaking emotion, speed, and volume.

answer_4.quote: We perform the human evaluation on a set of 200 samples using an A/B test for model comparison. Three human evaluators are assigned to each sample, and they are instructed to rate the model based on both the generated text and speech.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters compare two model outputs and rate them based on the quality of generated text and speech.
